problem: The product-led Powerhouse homepage had merged to protected main while Netlify production still served an older commit_ref.
root_cause: Netlify executed the full production build and first failed because apply-product-led-home.mjs targeted obsolete prototype-v18-stable.html. After parity was made exact, fail-closed i18n correctly exposed two uncached product-led strings ('Powerhouse closed loop' and standalone 'Intelligence'). Earlier premerge parity omitted the product-led build step and therefore could not expose either defect.
prevention: The product-led build step targets only current canonical artifacts and never assumes retired prototype files exist.
Every homepage runtime change executes apply-product-led-home.mjs inside the canonical premerge Netlify-parity build using the same command order as netlify.toml.
Product-led copy must either have static NL/EN cache coverage or reuse already-canonical translated product labels; accessibility-only text may not create an untracked translation dependency.
All generated HTML links use full canonical https://www.bedrijfsgeheugen.nl/ URLs.
A production promotion is incomplete until Netlify commit_ref contains the merged homepage change and the public homepage exposes Powerhouse Intelligence, Powerhouse Agents and Powerhouse Connect.
